title: Complemented zero-divisor graph of posets
summary: In this paper, we derive a set of equivalent conditions for the zero-divisor graph $Γ(Q)$ of a poset $Q$ with $0$ to be complemented, characterizing it in terms of quasi-complemented posets. Furthermore, we prove that the notions of a complemented zero-divisor graph and a uniquely complemented zero-divisor graph coincide for any poset $Q$ with $0$. In addition, we provide both algebraic and topological characterizations for $Γ(Q)$ to be a complemented graph. In the final section, we apply these characterizations to the zero-divisor graphs of a reduced (multiplicative) semigroup $S$ with $0$…
